lessons.claim: Every separation check can pass and the system still be unmeasurable. trap-drag passes all 7 hard checks, and yet the drag lag Δr_ss=γv/k_t=2.0nm is 1/10 of the trap's thermal fluctuation ℓ_k=20.4nm (SNR=0.0985), so the precision of ⟨F_drag⟩ over one crossing (independent samples T_obs/2τ_k=32,350) is 5.6% against a 2% target. 'Measurability SNR' and 'the target precision SEM/signal' have to go into L3 as statistical checks for it to be visible before running -- the separation checks alone do not show it.

not_verified: a prediction based on the analytic expression (SEM=ℓ_k/√n). Not confirmed by a run
